super_agent.name: Stage 2 Physical Implementation Orchestrator
super_agent.description: Orchestrates the ASIC Physical Design flow (Logic Synthesis to STA). Enforces an autonomous ECO feedback loop.

sub_agents.name: SubAgent2_1_LogicSynthesis
sub_agents.description: Analyzes Yosys synthesis logs, maps RTL to target PDK standard cells, and audits area utilization.

sub_agents.name: SubAgent2_2_Floorplanning
sub_agents.description: Verifies core aspect ratio, die area, macro pin placements, and Power Distribution Network (PDN) integrity.

sub_agents.name: SubAgent2_3_Placement
sub_agents.description: Analyzes RePLace global and detailed placement logs for localized congestion and overlap violations.

sub_agents.name: SubAgent2_4_CTS
sub_agents.description: Audits TritonCTS outputs for clock skew, insertion delay, and proper clock buffer utilization.

sub_agents.name: SubAgent2_5_Routing
sub_agents.description: Checks TritonRoute logs for DRC violations, shorts, minimum spacing, and antenna violations.

sub_agents.name: SubAgent2_6_STA_ECO
sub_agents.description: Deep-dives into OpenSTA reports (WNS/TNS). Proposes automated ECO fixes like gate sizing or buffer insertion.

sub_agents.name: SubAgent2_7_OutputVerifier
sub_agents.description: Independent auditor. Cross-references proposed ECOs and DRC analyses against physical design fundamentals to guarantee Zero-Hallucination.

sub_agents.name: SubAgent2_8_SignoffGate
sub_agents.description: The final decision maker. Evaluates the full backend pipeline and signs off the design for Stage 3 (Tape-out) OR triggers the Autonomous ECO Repair Loop.
